$comment: Package F: relation, evidence and photo basis per G20 element, applied to design/overlay/g20_comfort.json by tools/overlay/relations_g20.py (also called at the end of catalogue_g20.py). Basis rows are generated for photos 10-14 from the element's states plus the defaults below; 'seen', 'opaque', 'lit' and 'note' override them per photo ({photo: value}). lit: 'static' = the item is drawn whenever its screen is up (lit_expected true in 10-14). Rules (brief section 5): over = seen on top of our opaque pixels in 11/12/13; under = seen in 10/14 (or shown beneath our grid/labels in 10) and not seen in 11-13 where we were opaque, with the item plausibly in the same state; gone = 10/14 show the spot uncovered, same state, item absent; otherwise unknown.

10: photo 10 runs our transparent grid layout (grid.json): opaque only on the grid lines, the yellow labels, the L1-L16 / ATLAS text and the two swatch rows (250-1350 x 440-600)
11: early build (eefecfd-era layout, old geometry): its 'bg' wbback widget is a full-panel opaque backdrop at z 0 (shared/shaders.js WBBACK: 'opaque black over BMW's own gauges'); no stock content shows anywhere in 11 except BMW's over items
12: build cb28ce7: opaque full-panel background (C10 baked layer + WBBACK); our window was drawn, so the stockMap hole was off
13: build cb28ce7, same session as 12: opaque full-panel background, window drawn (hole off)
14: 0.7.2 with only our text layers drawn (unbound-sampler bug): our pixels are opaque only under our own glyphs

tt.brake.reason: Lit only in 08 (stock); unlit at a visible spot in 10/14; 11-13 cannot tell hidden from off.

tt.tpms.reason: Lit only in 08; unlit in 10/14; 11-13 inconclusive.

note.11: not seen: parking brake presumably released and Auto Hold off

tt.steering.safety_note: Safety review (F): kept critical although section 3's list does not name it: in 08 it is red-orange like the brake lamp, a steering-system fault is a stop/drive-carefully warning, and UN R79 requires a steering failure warning to be visible.

assist.cc_panel.safety_note: Safety review (F): raised to critical. The panel is the channel for check-control warnings, including the oil-pressure and coolant warnings that section 3 lists and that have no lamp among the catalogued telltales; a plan must not hide it without a redraw.
